description: Source code for the TiffIfd class, which manages TIFF Image File Directory (IFD) entries, including adding, removing, validating, and serializing IFD data within the Android img_utils library.

classes.name: TiffIfd
classes.description: Class representing a TIFF Image File Directory (IFD), managing its entries, offsets, and serialization.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a TiffEntry to the IFD, with bounds checking.

methods.name: setNextIfd
methods.description: Sets the next IFD in the chain.

methods.name: checkAndGetOffset
methods.description: Calculates and validates the offset for the IFD.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Serializes the IFD data to output.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the IFD in bytes.

methods.name: getComparableValue
methods.description: Returns a value suitable for comparison, based on IFD ID.

methods.name: validateAndSetStripTags
methods.description: Validates and sets strip-related tags in the IFD.

methods.name: uninitializedOffsets
methods.description: Checks if strip offsets are uninitialized.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the IFD.
